title: Bug Event v1
description: One append-only event in the event-sourced JSONL bug telemetry (v0.1.46 AC-1). Each line of a specs/bugs/<YYYYMMDDTHH>Z-<n>.jsonl file is one object validating this schema. A bug_id's stream opens with a `reported` event and carries at most one terminal event {resolved, superseded, deferred, rejected}; `archived` is a NON-terminal annotation (defined-but-unemitted this release); `picked` (v0.4.3 FR14) is a NON-terminal, repeatable observable reservation marker (NO-LOCKS DOCTRINE) valid only on an open stream.

bug_id.description: Stable identifier of the bug this event pertains to (kebab-case slug).

event.description: Event kind. `reported` opens the stream; {resolved, superseded, deferred, rejected} are terminal (at most one per bug_id); `archived` is a non-terminal annotation; `picked` (v0.4.3 FR14) is a non-terminal, repeatable reservation marker valid only on an open stream.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event was recorded.

reported_by.description: Agent or runtime that recorded the event (e.g. 'software-engineer').

component.description: reported: subsystem/module the bug lives in.

context.description: reported: active spec-context the bug was found in.

symptom.description: reported: what happened (the error / wrong output).

repro.description: reported: the exact command / steps to reproduce.

notes.description: reported: environment / logs — MUST be redacted of any operator-local path, IP, hostname, private repo name, or secret.

release.description: resolved: the release that fixed the bug ('unknown' sentinel when the source did not record it). picked (v0.4.3 FR14): the M.m.p release or hotfix id the bug is reserved under.

superseded_by.description: superseded: the backlog/bug slug that supersedes this bug.

evidence.description: resolved: legacy free-text narrative (v0.1.73 FR3, superseded as the CLI's blocking check by FR23/v0.4.4 — the three evidence_* fields below carry the checkable evidence now). Optional, kept for backward-compatible historical events.

evidence_loop.description: resolved (FR23, v0.4.4): the red-loop command that reproduced the bug on the executed path, before any hypothesis. REQUIRED at the CLI append path (blocking); optional in the schema so historical pre-FR23 resolved events remain valid — never rewritten (A23.2).

evidence_seam.description: resolved (FR23, v0.4.4): the test file/node (the regression seam) that pins the fix. REQUIRED at the CLI append path (blocking); optional in the schema so historical pre-FR23 resolved events remain valid — never rewritten (A23.2).

evidence_diff.description: resolved (FR23, v0.4.4): the diff direction on the touched feature — lines/branches/flags added vs removed, prefixed 'net-negative:'/'net-positive:'/'net-neutral:' so it is machine-checkable. A net-positive value routes to a software-architect review before the commit (DADAIA.md §6); does not hard-block the append. REQUIRED at the CLI append path (blocking); optional in the schema so historical pre-FR23 resolved events remain valid — never rewritten (A23.2).
